name: Dumah
overview: The topic of Dumah in Scripture encompasses both a personal and a geographical identity. Dumah is named as a son of Ishmael, linking him to the patriarchal lineage of Genesis 25:14. Additionally, Dumah is identified as a city within the territory of Judah, as recorded in Joshua 15:52. The prophetic oracle in Isaiah 21:11-12 features Dumah as a place associated with watchfulness and inquiry, emphasizing a spiritual call to vigilance and discernment amid uncertainty.
